candidate: C01 MassBank Europe Eawag EQ HCD NCE ladders first released after MassBank 2023.11 (releases 2024.06, 2024.11, 2025.10, plus unreleased dev PR #398)
task: S1 metadata-only overlap and feasibility screen

method.record_universe: git trees of MassBank/MassBank-data (blobless bare clone, dev=befc8a1e2f2aef899747797c081a5d80fab12fe7, tag 2025.10=fd8fb15e44035c53c9d937307c04ba62ebec606d) for Eawag/MSBNK-Eawag-EQ*.txt at tags 2023.09, 2023.11, 2024.06, 2024.11, 2025.05.1, 2025.10, 2026.03 and dev; 12,185 record paths, 5,051 first appearing after 2023.11
method.record_metadata: GitHub code-search text-match fragments, header lines only; PK$ and every non-header line discarded in memory and never written (0 peak-like lines in the stored files). Index blob sha equals the dev tree blob for all 5,051 records; blob at tag 2025.10 equals blob at dev for all 4,381 tagged-release records, so the CE strings read are the 2025.10 content.
method.identity: MURU parent_connectivity_key and scaffold_group_v2 recomputed with scripts/ce_interface_adjudication/scaffold_key.py (rdkit 2026.03.5); overlap tested on both the recorded InChIKey first block and the MURU parent key
method.tautomer_recheck: step 4 adds a canonical-tautomer key and a formula-constrained heavy-atom skeleton key against MassSpecGym 1.5, the MURU development population, the PR #7 population and the comparator common population

criteria.1_absent_from_MURU_development: MET for the clean tiers. 233 of 403 candidate compounds are in the MURU exposure registry (110 in the 1,325-compound v2 development population); they are removed. Scaffold-group novelty is a separate tier: 243 of 403 share a development-population scaffold group and 334 share a registry scaffold group.
criteria.2_absent_from_PR7_confirmation_populatio: MET. 0 of 403 compounds and 0 scaffold groups are in the 1,794-compound MSnLib confirmation study 2 population; no tautomer or skeleton hit either.
criteria.3_absent_from_comparator_benchmark_popul: MET. 0 of 403 compounds and 0 scaffold groups are in the 1,327-compound comparator common population; no tautomer or skeleton hit either.
criteria.4_absent_from_ICEBERG_GLACIER_training: MET after exclusion, with one demonstrated tautomer leak removed. 256 of 403 compounds are in MassSpecGym 1.5 (all folds) by recorded or parent key, 237 in the ms-pred msg_simulation labels. One further compound (clethodim, new key PHXHZCIAPNNPTQ) is in MassSpecGym as the enol tautomer IOYNQIMAUDJVEI and is only caught by the canonical-tautomer key.
criteria.5_known_CE_semantics: MET. Every one of the 5,051 records carries a single-valued AC$MASS_SPECTROMETRY: COLLISION_ENERGY of the form 'N % (nominal)'. The MassBank record format documentation gives '10% (nominal)' as the CE example, and the RMassBank configuration that generates Eawag records writes ce: '35 % (nominal)' for a scan commented 'CID 35% NCE', i.e. the quantity is the instrument normalized collision energy setting in percent. These records are not in MassSpecGym, so the MassSpecGym convention (NCE*precursor_mz/500 for %-strings) is a documented convention applied downstream, not a property of the source.
criteria.6_MH_positive_available: MET. 3,295 [M+H]+ positive MS2 records; every screened compound is defined on [M+H]+ records.
criteria.7_fragmentation_instrument_compatibility: MET. All 3,295 [M+H]+ records are FRAGMENTATION_MODE HCD, MS_TYPE MS2, AC$INSTRUMENT_TYPE LC-ESI-QFT on Orbitrap platforms (Exploris 240 under two spellings, Q Exactive Plus, Q Exactive), resolution 15,000 or 17,500. ms-pred maps QFT to the single Orbitrap token (instrument2onehot_pos in src/ms_pred/common/chem_utils.py:277-283); the ms-pred msg labels use only Orbitrap and QTOF. Not compatible and not present: QTOF, ion-trap CID (IT-FT), stepped or assisted multi-energy scans. Negative-mode records (1,756) are out of MURU scope.
criteria.8_multiple_energies_per_compound: MET. 403 of 415 compounds have at least 3 distinct NCE values; the dominant ladder is 15,30,45,60,75,90,120,150,180 (67 of the 111 compound-level clean compounds). Within MURU's 15-90 window the median compound has 6 rungs; NCE 60 is present for 108 of 111, NCE 20 for only 5.
criteria.9_structural_diversity_after_exclusions: 58 compounds in 57 scaffold groups (42 Butina clusters at Morgan2 Tanimoto distance 0.6) at the primary tier; 44/44 conservative; 41/41 strict. All are authentic standard compounds (CONFIDENCE 'standard compound'), 0 non-CHNOPS-halogen elements, precursor m/z median 397, 18 at or above 500, max 784.5, all inside the MURU development [M+H]+ range 70.0-1,042.6.
criteria.10_license_and_access: MET. Every clean compound's records carry LICENSE: CC BY-SA (an allowed MassBank value; COPYRIGHT (C) Eawag 2022-2026). Public access: GitHub MassBank/MassBank-data (default branch dev; the API reports no repository-level license file), released versions via Zenodo doi 10.5281/zenodo.3378723 and MassBank Europe. Share-alike applies to redistribution of derived record collections.
criteria.11_hidden_massspecgym_inclusion_plausibi: PARTIAL. Release timing argues against it: the earliest of these records was merged to dev on 2024-06-04 (PR #258) and released 2024-06-05, after MassSpecGym's source download (notebook 1 says 13/05/2024, paper says 27/05/2024) of MassBank release 2023.11. But re-deposition of an older Eawag compound under a changed structural representation is real and was observed: 27 candidate compounds reuse an Eawag UCHEM id that already had pre-2023.11 records; 26 are already excluded as MassSpecGym compounds, and the 27th (UCHEM 3178) has pre-2023.11 records whose InChIKey is IOYNQIMAUDJVEI while the new records use PHXHZCIAPNNPTQ, the same substance in a different tautomeric form (Morgan Tanimoto between them is only 0.54). It is excluded here. After that exclusion no remaining clean compound shares an Eawag UCHEM id with a pre-2023.11 record. Residual, unresolvable with metadata only: Eawag spectra reaching MoNA or GNPS by another route, and re-representations that neither the canonical-tautomer key nor the formula-constrained skeleton key unifies.

recommended_evaluation_set.definition: compounds with at least 3 distinct NCE values, [M+H]+, HCD, LC-ESI-QFT, first released after MassBank 2023.11; excluded if the compound key (recorded or MURU parent), its canonical tautomer key, or its formula-constrained skeleton key is in MassSpecGym 1.5 (any fold), the ms-pred msg_simulation labels, the MURU exposure registry, the PR #7 population or the comparator common population; and, at the primary tier, if its scaffold group is in the MURU development population, the PR #7 population or the comparator population
